findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: robots_check, page_meta, mcp_servers, link_check, email_verify, extract_json, x402_services · Private data: llm_pricing_sample, free_tiers, llm_pricing, llm_cost, email_verify · Public sink: apis_search, free_tiers, robots_check, page_meta, dataset_full, llm_pricing, llm_cost, mcp_servers, page_check, link_check, country, holidays, currency, base_gas, page_markdown, dump_mcp_servers, dump_llm_pricing, dump_world_reference, email_verify, extract_json, x402_services, agent_tools, dump_x402_services, dump_agent_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: robots_check, page_meta, mcp_servers, link_check, email_verify, extract_json, x402_services · Private data: llm_pricing_sample, free_tiers, llm_pricing, llm_cost, email_verify · Public sink: apis_search, free_tiers, robots_check, page_meta, dataset_full, llm_pricing, llm_cost, mcp_servers, page_check, link_check, country, holidays, currency, base_gas, page_markdown, dump_mcp_servers, dump_llm_pricing, dump_world_reference, email_verify, extract_json, x402_services, agent_tools, dump_x402_services, dump_agent_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
